description: For board work without an account, reuse this task’s guest session; start one only when none exists. Use the returned guestToken to search parts, create_board, then generate_layout. Reuse an authorized account when available. Use claim_guest_board to save an existing guest board after sign-in. Returns guestToken, viewerUrl, limits and expiresAt; a null expiresAt means no scheduled expiration. Edits, layouts, checks, previews and both export formats have no lifetime count limits. Normal request-rate, compute-capacity and board-complexity limits apply. Starting a new session does not recover an earlier session.
name: start_guest_session
title: Start a guest board session
